title: Reliability sync - short prep & post-actions
content:
Quick brain dump for tomorrow's weekly reliability sync (15–20m slice + follow-ups). Keep this high level — use to steer agenda and capture actions.

Context / tone notes:
- Short, scoreboard-first: SLO deltas, paging volume, top 2 regressions.
- Save deep dive for follow-on breakout if needed.
- Primary ask: align on paging reduction actions and canary plan for model-serving rollout.

Agenda (proposed, 20m):
1) Quick scoreboard (3–4 min) — SLOs, error rate trend, P99 latency delta.
2) Paging trends (4–5 min) — who is paged the most, recurring noise, suppressed alerts.
3) Top incidents / postmortem status (5 min) — progress on SRE-842, SRE-865.
4) Action-once (5 min) — owners for mitigations + canary fallback cadence.
5) AOB / blockers (2 min).

Scoreboard (notes to turn into 1-slide):
- Request SLO (global): 99.5% success last week -> 99.3% this week (delta -0.2pp).
- P50/P95/P99 latencies for hosted-api-gen model endpoints: 120ms / 260ms / 1,120ms (P99 up +18% vs prior week).
- Paging volume: 48 pages last 7 days (avg 6.8/day) vs baseline 35 (increase +37%).
- Churn: ~40% of pages are duplicates from same origin service (edge-cache TTL misconfig).

Paging trends quick findings:
- Top noisy pager: "model-eviction" alert firing from hosting-executor cluster — noisy around warm-up bursts and rolling restarts. Owner: Ethan (SRE-ops).
- Second: high memory reclaim on dedicated pools during overnight batch jobs (jobs-runner team). Owner: Rina to coordinate.
- Several pages correlate with a spike in IO wait on nvme behind a single host (infra alert). Flagged to infra team (SRE-865).

Top incidents and status:
- SRE-842: partial degradation of caching layer causing higher model cold-starts. Root cause: TTL miscalculation in prefix cache invalidation. Draft postmortem submitted; mitigation patch in PR 412. ETA for rollout: canary Mon 5/30.
- SRE-865: intermittent NVMe IO saturation causing transient P99 spikes. Investigation found one host with degraded firmware. Infra ticket created; replacement imminent. Mitigation: temporary routing away from host via scheduler.

Hypotheses to surface during sync (one-liners):
- Increased P99 largely due to prefix cache TTL + eviction storms; combined with NVMe hot spot -> compounding latency.
- Paging increase driven by noisy model-eviction alert that can be tuned (increase threshold or add cooldown).

Immediate actions to propose (owner / ETA):
- Merge and canary PR 412 for cache TTL fix (Ethan) / canary 5/30, full rollout 6/2 if no regression.
- Add 5m cooldown to model-eviction alert -> reduce duplicate noise (Maya) / patch alerting 5/27.
- Schedule infra host replacement and temporary scheduler drain (Rina + infra) / in progress, replacement 5/28.
- Run targeted synthetic traffic test to reproduce cold-start pattern (Dev-Ex) and validate fix (Ethan) / test 5/29.

Follow-up items to capture after sync (checklist):
- Capture final canary window and rollback plan in Rocket ticket -> link in summary email.
- Confirm cost impact estimate if TTL increases (Optimize team) -> quick calc.
- Update ops runbook for model-eviction paging (short doc).
- Add paged-on-call rotation blameless review for recurring duplicates (next week's retro).

Open questions / risks to voice:
- If cache TTL change reduces hit rate transiently, what's acceptable SLO hit during rollout? (propose 1% SLA buffer)
- Any rolling restart schedule that might align poorly with canary window? (Coord w/ release-eng.)
- Do we need an emergency rate-limiter for canary if latency regressions spike? (temp traffic shaping)

Notes / rough script for the sync (so I don't waffle):
- "Team — quick heads up: P99 is up and we're seeing more pages. We have two parallel root causes tracked (cache TTL + one infra host). We're proposing a targeted fix (PR 412) and infra replacement; canary plan is set. Asking for thumbs on alert cooldown and confirmation of scheduler drain timing"

Personal reminders (Maya):
- Draft summary email to #sre-ops + product-hosted-api after sync (include links to SRE-842/865 and PR 412).
- Remind release-eng about canary windows and overlap with other deploys.
- Block 30m on 5/29 to run synthetic verification with Dev-Ex.

Rough links to paste into slide / email post-sync:
- PR 412: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/412
- JIRA SRE-842: https://jirahost/browse/SRE-842
- JIRA SRE-865: https://jirahost/browse/SRE-865
- Synthetic test checklist: internal confluence link (will paste after run).

Closing thought: keep the meeting tight; surface owners and commit to rollouts or explicit deferrals. If nobody volunteers for cooldown on the model-eviction alert, I'll push the patch post-sync and log it as a config-only change.

-- end of draft prep notes --

(Do not include this file in the shared weekly deck until PR 412 is merged; keep as personal prep.)
